III. Read the passage and choose the correct answer (36–41)

Teenagers often feel stress because of exams and school pressure. Many students join school clubs such as chess clubs, sports clubs, and music clubs. They also use Facebook forums to talk with friends and discuss problems. Teachers advise students to stay calm and prepare for exams carefully. Joining clubs helps students feel relaxed and more confident. Teenagers should balance study and entertainment.

Gõ toàn bộ câu hoàn chỉnh vào ô bên dưới. Hệ thống không phân biệt chữ hoa/thường và khoảng trắng thừa.

II. Rewrite the sentences without changing their meaning (45–49)

Gõ phần còn thiếu của câu vào ô trống dưới đây.

45. Many teenagers feel stressed because of exams.

→ Exams cause

46. Exams are difficult, so students feel pressure.

→ Because

47. Joining school clubs helps students feel relaxed.

→ Students feel relaxed when they

48. "Do you feel stressed before tests?" he asked me.

→ He asked me

49. School clubs are more enjoyable than staying at home.

→ Staying at home is not

QUICK REVIEW - ÔN TẬP NHANH UNIT 3

Từ vựng quan trọng:

  • • stressed (adj): bị căng thẳng
  • • pressure (n): áp lực
  • • enjoyable (adj): thú vị, vui vẻ
  • • forum (n): diễn đàn

Cấu trúc cần nhớ:

  • • because + clause (chỉ nguyên nhân): because exams are coming.
  • • because of + N/V-ing: because of exams.
  • • so + clause (chỉ kết quả): ..., so students feel pressure.
  • • should + V-bare: Students should stay calm.
